{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
# Remove any potential thousands separators (though none appear in sample)
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

print("Number of loyal completed orders:", len(loyal_completed))
print("Mean revenue:", mean_revenue)"}
